name: Sakuragatari
source:
I may have no memory of being spirited away, but there are three things I remember- the shadow of somebody who took my hand, the scent of flowers and a voice that said "Come", and a voice that said, "Don't come."

It was the usual path home. Suddenly, I then realised I became lost in an unfamiliar street. Next to me was the figure of "Makoto", my childhood friend hurrying on the path home. My mobile was out of range. With no way to go back as there was no path we came from, the fog intensified and all we could do was set on going forwards. After a while, we found a large mansion and a huge, naked cherry blossom tree. Anxiously, we decide to visit, and were answered with--

"Why did you come? I told you not come, didn't I?"

The young man, "Fubuki", glared at us, appearing to be displeased.

Even though we were told not to come, it was pitch black around us and we had no idea how to get home. All Makoto and I could do was borrow a room and stay for the night.

After the night, we left the mansion. We then became enveloped in mist and despaired in the grey scenery. The fog, thick and white, wrapped our surroundings, and the forest that extended to the large garden was very dense...
The Hanamo-machi we lived in... was nowhere to be found.
This place isn't the world as I know it.

"Welcome to Hanari."

It was the residents of the mansion that welcomed us.
The ones who welcomed us were - "Taruhi", "Hinata" and "Kirishima".
In the garden was a lifeless cherry blossom tree. Gradually, it made me remember being spirited away.
The shadow of the one that took my hand.
And, the voice that said "Come", and the voice that said "Don't come".

I got cursed.
They said I could go by in this mysterious world without care, but unrelentingly, they pressed me to make an ultimate choice.
There is no right answer anywhere, but they said I can only make one choice.

If so...
If you'll take my hand, if you choose me, if you're destined to not be able to live without me...

"I will give it to you, anything and everything."

[Translation of the official website's story]
translation:
我可能不记得被偷走的事，但我记得三件事——牵着我手的人影、花香和一个说“来”的声音，一个说“别来”的声音。

这是平常回家的路。突然，我发现自己在一条陌生的街道上迷路了。旁边是儿时好友“诚”的身影，他正匆匆走在回家的路上。我的手机超出了覆盖范围。由于无路可退，雾气越来越大，我们只能继续前进。过了一会儿，我们发现了一座大宅邸和一棵巨大的、光秃秃的樱花树。我们焦急地决定去拜访，但得到的答复是——

“你怎么来了？我不是说过你不来吗？”

青年“吹雪”瞪着我们，一脸不高兴。

尽管我们被告知不要来，但我们周围一片漆黑，我们不知道如何回家。我和真琴所能做的就是借一个房间住一晚。

入夜后，我们离开了别墅。然后我们就被雾气笼罩，对灰色的景色感到绝望。浓浓的白雾包裹着我们的周围，一直延伸到大花园的森林非常茂密……
我们住的花茂町……已经找不到了。
这个地方不是我所知道的世界。

“欢迎来到哈纳里。”

迎接我们的是宅邸的居民。
迎接我们的是——“垂日”、“日向”、“雾岛”。
花园里有一棵毫无生气的樱花树。渐渐地，我想起了被偷偷带走的事。
那个拉着我手的人的影子。
还有，说“来”的声音，和说“别来”的声音。

我被诅咒了。
他们说我可以无忧无虑地在这个神秘的世界里度过，但他们却无情地逼迫我做出最终的选择。
任何地方都没有正确的答案，但他们说我只能做出一个选择。

如果是这样的话…
如果你握住我的手，如果你选择我，如果你注定不能没有我……

“我会把它给你，任何东西。”

【官网故事翻译】
